name: Basic Meal / Snack
description: You combine ingredients to create a dish that counts as two meals or two individual Snacks.
ingredients: 2 of the following : Cup of Beans, Piece of Meat, 2 Vegetables, 2 Fruit or Cup of Rice

name: Improved Meal / Snack
description: You combine ingredients to create a dish that counts as two Meals or two individual Snacks.
ingredients: 4 of the following : Cup of Beans, Piece of Meat, 2 Vegetables, 2 Fruit or Cup of Rice
A Splash of Cheap Wine or Whiskey

name: Pot of Stew
description: You create a large pot of Stew meant to be shared by multiple people, equal to 10 Meals.

name: Sweet Snack
description: You create 2 sweetened snacks packed with energy, that upon consumption temporarily suppresses any effects of exhaustion for 1 hour. You can only benefit from this effect once per Full Rest.

name: Pet Snack
description: You create 2 snacks designed for a Beast. Any Animal Checks made towards the Beast that consumes this snack gains a +2 Bonus for the next hour.

name: Jerky
description: You create 2 snacks packed with protein. After taking your next Breather, regain 1d4 Health. You can only benefit from this Health Bonus once per Full Rest.

name: Feast of the Valiant
description: You Create a Bountiful Feast that can be shared with multiple people, equal to 20 Meals. Anyone who spends at least 1 Hour consuming at least one meal from the Feast recovers an extra 3d4 Health after their next Full Rest.
ingredients: 10 Chunks of Meat or a Medium-Sized Beast

name: Fancy Meal / Snack
description: You combine ingredients to create a dish that counts as two Meals or two individual Snacks.
ingredients: 4 of the following : Cup of Beans, Piece of Meat, 2 Vegetables, 2 Fruit or Cup of Rice

name: Fortifying Snack
description: You create a 2 Fortifying Snacks that grants Cold and Fire Mitigation equal to your Cooking Modifier after 1 Hour that lasts until the end of your next Full Rest.

name: Banquet of Heroes
description: You Create a Bountiful Feast that can be shared with multiple people, equal to 20 Meals. Anyone who spends at least 1 Hour consuming at least one meal from the Banquet gains 2d8 Temporary Health and recovers an extra 2d8 Health after their next Full Rest.
ingredients: 20 Chunks of Meat or a Large-Sized Beast

name: Augment Food [Egg]
description: Add an Egg to an unfinished Recipe to increase the Focus Points recovered at the end of a Full Rest. Requires Cooking Augmentations.

name: Augment Food [Meat]
description: Add Special Meat to an unfinished Recipe to increase the Health Points recovered at the end of a Full Rest. Requires Cooking Augmentations.
